title: Will Bitcoin make a fresh all-time high?
thesis: When Bitcoin prints a new all-time high, risk-on flows rotate into the #2 coin — Ethereum has historically outrun BTC itself in the month after.

best_expression.plain_label: Own the two majors — BTC + ETH

plain_one_liner: Will Bitcoin make a fresh all-time high?
plain_summary: After each of 30 fresh BTC all-time highs since 2013, Ethereum rose +26.6% on average over the next month (77% of the time).
short_title: Will Bitcoin make a fresh all-time high?

title: Will a court rule against Big Tech?
thesis: Counter-intuitively, Google rallied after 'guilty' antitrust rulings — because the market had priced a forced break-up, and every ruling that stopped short was a relief.
plain_one_liner: Will a court rule against Big Tech?
plain_summary: After three adverse Google rulings, GOOGL was +8.1% a month later — the relief-rally when a break-up was avoided.
short_title: Will a court rule against Big Tech?
